items.title: What Regeneron Pharmaceuticals Doubters Overlooked
items.summary: If Regeneron Pharmaceuticals was on your watchlist rather than in your portfolio, the return may sting. For Regeneron Pharmaceuticals shareholders, the return over the past year was 24.3%, including dividends. That outcome landed between a bullish case built on Dupixent and EYLEA capturing larger global markets and a bearish view focused on healthcare reform and biosimilars squeezing margins. items.title: Insmed Snags A Whopping Price Tag As Sanofi Confirms Rumored Buyout
items.summary: Sanofi said Tuesday it would spend $41 billion to acquire Insmed in the biggest biotech buyout since Pfizer bought Seagen for $43 billion.
